name: MO-07
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent Eric Burlison running with a large financial edge
Democratic challenger minimally funded with no outside support
Prediction markets price Republican win at ~96%
model.rationale: This southwest Missouri seat is deeply Republican, Burlison is an incumbent who has raised roughly $1.5 million against a Democratic challenger with about $50,000, and markets give Democrats only a ~3% chance. No polls or expert ratings suggest any reason to move from the fundamentals.
model.watch: A late scandal or unexpected incumbent stumble is essentially the only path to making this competitive.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Eric Burlison seeks a second full term in a southwest Missouri district that leans about 21 points Republican at the baseline. He enters the general election with roughly $960,000 on hand after raising about $1.5 million, while Democrat Missi Hesketh has raised only about $50,000 and shows no outside spending on either side. A Libertarian candidate is also on the ballot.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets put the Republican's win probability near 96%. With the incumbent renominated, a dominant fundraising position, and a district this red, the race is rated Safe Republican with high confidence.
